findings.title: Mandiant MNDT-2026-0041 disclosure for CVE-2026-111560
findings.summary_md: Mandiant's disclosure records Barracuda reporting CVE-2026-111560 on October 15, 2026. The flaw is an OS command injection (CWE-78, CVSS 4.0 8.6) in the timezone configuration field of six Barracuda products, allowing an authenticated administrator to execute commands as root. Affected versions include ESG <= 9.4.0.27, ADC <= 6.4.0, WAF <= 11.0.1, WSG <= 16.1.100.100, BMA <= 5.5.4.0, and WCC <= 2.2.1. The CVE and Mandiant advisory were published on November 2.

findings.title: Mandiant MNDT-2026-0042 disclosure for CVE-2026-116606
findings.summary_md: Mandiant's disclosure records Barracuda reporting CVE-2026-116606 on October 22, 2026. The vulnerability is a pre-authentication authorization bypass (CWE-288, CVSS 4.0 9.3 Critical) in Barracuda Email Security Gateway versions earlier than 9.4.0.030, allowing an unauthenticated remote attacker to restore a crafted backup archive and modify the appliance's global configuration. The CVE and Mandiant advisory were published on November 2.

findings.title: Ostorlab analysis of Barracuda ESG pre-auth bypass to root
findings.summary_md: Ostorlab's November 2 analysis details the chained exploitation of CVE-2026-116606 (pre-auth authorization bypass) and CVE-2026-111560 (root command injection) across six Barracuda product lines. It notes Mandiant's disclosure timeline (October 15 and October 22 reports), that patches shipped November 2, that no exploitation is known as of that date, and that the 2023 Barracuda ESG flaw CVE-2023-2868 was previously exploited at scale, giving this appliance line a live attack history.
